description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

State Farm is hiring a Software Engineer for its Claims-Engineering team within Enterprise Technology. The role focuses on building and maintaining deployment automation and infrastructure for claims applications, including CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, infrastructure as code, and production support.
Software Engineer building CI/CD and GitOps deployment systems for Java containers on Kubernetes and OpenShift

Responsibilities:
• Build the CI/CD pipelines that deploy containerized Java applications across environments
• Write and maintain Kubernetes and OpenShift manifests and deployment configuration
• Work on infrastructure as code and on the in-house deployment tooling written in Go, Python, and Bash
• Help move deployment configuration toward a GitOps model
• Build and patch container base images and application images
• Diagnose and fix deployment and environment problems, picking up production support responsibilities as you go
• Write runbooks, decision records, and team documentation
• Apply skills, tools, security processes, applications, environments, and programming languages to complete assignments with guidance and direction from experienced engineers
• Maintain and develop understanding of software engineering topics including version control, CI/CD, containers, and compute environments including Linux and Public Cloud
• Leverage inner source best practices to encourage code discoverability and collaboration across the enterprise

Requirements:
• Containers and Kubernetes: images, pods, services, and deployment configuration
• CI/CD pipeline experience
• Linux fundamentals
• Scripting and automation in Python, Bash, or Go
• Git and version control workflow
• Comfortable reading Java application code and application server logs
• A real willingness to learn
• Curious. Willing to dig into unfamiliar code and infrastructure, ask questions, and follow a problem all the way down
• Collaborative. Works well with cross-functional teams and senior engineers, and says clearly where things stand
• Takes ownership of work from development through production
• Writes things down. Contributes to runbooks, decision records, and documented processes
• Takes code review feedback well and wants to learn from the senior engineers around you
• Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity

Preferred:
• OpenShift or ROSA a strong plus
• ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling
• Infrastructure as code (Terraform)
• Observability tooling (Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana)
• Secrets management
• AWS fundamentals
